findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant` and `documentTenant` differ, this function now returns `true`. Callers relying on this authorization predicate can therefore expose one tenant’s documents to another tenant, directly reversing the prior tenant-isolation contract.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any user whose `userTenant` differs from a document’s `documentTenant` can read that cross-tenant document, violating the access-control contract and exposing tenant data.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant equality enforcement
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any input where `userTenant !== documentTenant` returns `true`, bypassing tenant isolation and permitting cross-tenant document access for callers relying on this authorization check.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
